status: Baseline inventory; notification fields planned at this source revision. Native implementation and runtime acceptance must be tracked separately.
limits: No runtime or actual installed configuration inspection.
Map and set entries are represented as owning containers, not arbitrary plugin-owned configuration. TrafficMonitor-owned plugin enable/visibility/display metadata remains in scope.
Other carrier operations are preserved as exact source evidence, not automatically classified as editable settings.
No claim of complete settings acceptance or feature completion.
scopeNotes: Counts are descriptor field units, with NotifyTipSettings expanded into enable and tip_value; six FontInfo leaves are retained as compound expansion rather than increasing the descriptor count.
remaining_native_migration means absent from NativeSettings Values. Existing legacy controls or productive workflows remain source evidence, not missing product behavior.
The three settings structs contain 66 remaining migration units beyond the 13 planned Notifications leaves. MainConfigData contributes eight additional preference/container units.

MainConfigData visibility, connection and history workflow state is separated from mandatory missing Settings rows. Window geometry is separate. Config-only taskbar right-space fallback is retained explicitly.
The four taskbar dft_* values are computed fallback inputs, not separately saved keys. Read references mentioning them as defaults do not make them persisted preferences.
Relevant auxiliary installed carrier operations are retained, including other/debug/capability/warning state. These are not automatically user-editable controls.
Exact source snippets remain literal technical evidence. This file has no actual host paths, PIDs, installed setting values or credentials.
